claims.supporting_excerpt: i sent out yesterday about the california energy commissions conclusions on the states natural gas infrastructure

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.supporting_excerpt: the california energy commission cec staff last week released its final draft report on the states natural gas infrastructure concluding that it is constrained and has caused higherthanaverage wholesale gas prices

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.supporting_excerpt: confirming what the states energy crisis made abundantly clear months ago

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.object: market manipulation contributed to higher natural gas prices
claims.supporting_excerpt: the report did not totally rule out market manipulation as a culprit it concludes that a combination of infrastructure shortcomings and possible market manipulation has to the higher natural gas prices in california

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.object: final draft report on natural gas infrastructure
claims.supporting_excerpt: it will go to the fivemember commission for approval aug 22

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.supporting_excerpt: the 111page report natural gas infrastructure issues prepared by the cec electricity and natural gas committee

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.supporting_excerpt: the report recommends that the cec work more closely with the california public utilities commission to develop a new curtailment policy

claims.subject: California Energy Commission
claims.supporting_excerpt: it also proposes that the cec this fall conduct a workshop to determine ways to have noncore large energyintensive customers better optimize their use of natural gas storage
